contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 100000","description":"The number of officers N must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= C <= 1000000000","description":"Chef's initial coordinate C must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= P[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))","description":"All officer coordinates must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P5","expression":"all(P[i] != C for i in range(N))","description":"No officer can be at the same coordinate as Chef."},{"id":"P6","expression":"len(set(P)) == N","description":"All officer coordinates must be unique."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{max_eliminated} {result}'","description":"The output must contain the maximum number of officers eliminated and whether Chef runs away or is caught."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"max_eliminated >= 0 and max_eliminated <= N","description":"The maximum number of officers eliminated must be between 0 and N."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"result in {1, -1}","description":"The result must be 1 if Chef runs away, or -1 if Chef is caught."}],"invariants
